title: Total influence via Fourier coefficients
statement:
For every Boolean function $f\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$, the total influence of $f$ is recovered from its Fourier--Walsh spectrum by
\[
  I[f] \;=\; \sum_{S\subseteq[n]} \abs{S}\,\hat f(S)^2,
\]
where the sum ranges over all subsets $S$ of $[n]=\{1,\dots,n\}$, $\abs{S}$ is the cardinality of $S$, and $\hat f(S)$ is the Fourier--Walsh coefficient of $f$ at frequency $S$.
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function of arity n (f : {0,1}^n → ℝ)
